title: Morning 9:45 AM machine-complete pre-flight run_state artifact
description: Structure of the run_state.json written by the 9:45 AM ET morning DCA pre-flight validation (executor mode 'preflight', run_type 'morning_dca_preflight'). Schema version 'morning-preflight-v2-machine-complete'. Introduced Mon Jul 13 2026 after the 10:30 AM live execution was blocked because the 9:45 artifact lacked machine-readable gate fields: the top-level overall_ok flag and a per-ticker eligibility list the 10:30 live task can consume without re-deriving. The artifact is read-only/analytics (no orders, no Robinhood review, no broker placement) and never writes into the afternoon ce16ba6b tree. It carries the shared morning run_classification block (validated against morning_run_classification.schema.json) and stream='morning', valid_afternoon_evidence=false. additionalProperties stays true so the ladder/budget/signal_rows fields the executor already emits keep validating alongside the machine gate fields.

overall_ok.description: True when the pre-flight artifact is valid and the 10:30 live task may consume it. It is false ONLY for global/account/buying-power/auth/schema-write failures. Individual unresolved or ineligible tickers (see per_ticker_eligibility / unresolved_tickers) never force overall_ok=false as long as the other required fields were written.

eligible_count.description: Number of per_ticker_eligibility rows with eligible_to_execute=true.

ineligible_count.description: Number of per_ticker_eligibility rows with eligible_to_execute=false (includes unresolved-ticker rows).

unresolved_tickers.description: Active-universe symbols that could not be resolved (lookup/quote/prior-close/tradability failure). Each appears exactly once and is also present as a per_ticker_eligibility row with eligible_to_execute=false and ineligible_reason='unresolved_ticker' (or a specific lookup/tradability failure code). Unresolved symbols do NOT set overall_ok=false.

blocking_errors.description: Global/account/auth/schema-write failures that DO invalidate the run (overall_ok=false). Per-ticker resolution failures do not belong here — they go on the ticker row's ineligible_reason.

warnings.description: Non-blocking advisories (e.g. budget cap overage, per-ticker data notes).

run_classification.description: Authoritative morning scheduled-vs-manual classification. run_type='morning_dca_preflight', stream='morning', state_schema_version='morning-preflight-v2-machine-complete', valid_afternoon_evidence=false.

per_ticker_eligibility.description: One row per active-universe symbol, each symbol appearing exactly once. The 10:30 live task reads eligible_to_execute here to decide which tickers to re-evaluate.

active_universe.description: True for every symbol in the active morning universe (all rows).

quote_available.description: A usable current/opening quote was resolved for the symbol.

tradable.description: Best-effort tradability pre-screen (a resolvable, quotable, prior-close-bearing symbol). Authoritative broker tradability is re-checked by the 10:30 live run.

account_ok.description: Account/global readiness. Null when the coarse read-only pre-flight did not bind a broker account; the 10:30 live run performs the authoritative account check.

buying_power_ok.description: Buying-power readiness. Null when not evaluated by the read-only pre-flight; the 10:30 live run checks fresh buying power/budget.

spread_pct.description: Bid/ask spread percent. Null when the coarse pre-flight does not evaluate spread (the 10:30 live run computes it fresh).

spread_ok.description: Spread within tolerance. Null when spread is not evaluated by the pre-flight.

trend_status.description: Intraday trend state. The 9:45 pre-flight does not have a 60-minute window, so it emits 'not_evaluated_preflight'; the 10:30 live run validates the trend fresh.

data_confidence_status.description: 'resolved' when quote and prior close are usable, 'unresolved' when the symbol could not be resolved, 'degraded' when partial/low-confidence data was used.

early_drop_pct.description: Morning drop vs. yesterday's regular-session close (percent). Null when unresolved.

early_multiplier.description: Graded ladder multiplier from the early drop. Null/0 when no qualifying drop.

hypothetical_amount.description: Hypothetical dollar size (base_amount_usd x early_multiplier). Pre-flight is read-only, so this is hypothetical only.

eligible_to_execute.description: Coarse pre-screen verdict: should the 10:30 live evaluator re-evaluate this symbol? NOT a final buy approval.

ineligible_reason.description: Null when eligible_to_execute=true. Otherwise a reason code, e.g. 'unresolved_ticker', 'quote_unavailable', 'prior_close_unavailable', 'not_tradable', 'no_qualifying_drop', 'account_not_ok', 'buying_power_not_ok'.
